37356-sex-love-and-its-place-in-a-free-s.title: Sex Love And Its Place In A Free Society
37356-sex-love-and-its-place-in-a-free-s.creator: Unknown
37356-sex-love-and-its-place-in-a-free-s.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Of course Nature (personifying under this term the more unconscious, even though human, instincts and forces) takes pretty good care in her own way that most people should have sexual experience. She has her own purposes to work out, which in a sense have nothing to do with the individual--her racial purposes. But she acts in the rough, with tremendous sweep and power, and with little adjustment to or consideration for the later developed and more conscious and intelligent ideals of humanity.

7951-glimpses-of-bengal-selected-from-th.title: Glimpses Of Bengal Selected From The Letters Of Sir Rabindra
7951-glimpses-of-bengal-selected-from-th.creator: Sir Rabindranath Tagore
7951-glimpses-of-bengal-selected-from-th.description: A book by Sir Rabindranath Tagore. aves and heaves and blanches into foam. It sets me thinking of some tied-up monster straining at its bonds, in front of whose gaping jaws we build our homes on the shore and watch it lashing its tail. What immense strength, with waves swelling like the muscles of a giant!

arxiv-1503-06394.title: Large-scale Log-determinant Computation through Stochastic Chebyshev Expansions
arxiv-1503-06394.creator: Insu Han, Dmitry Malioutov, Jinwoo Shin
arxiv-1503-06394.description: Abstract Logarithms of determinants of large positive definite matrices appear ubiquitously in machine learning applications including Gaussian graphical and Gaussian process models, partition functions of discrete graphical models, minimum-volume ellipsoids, metric learning and kernel learning. Log-determinant computation involves the Cholesky decomposition at the cost cubic in the number of variables, i.e.

arxiv-2005-13516.title: Genetic algorithm with cross validation-based epidemic model and application to early diffusion of COVID-19 in Algeria
arxiv-2005-13516.creator: M. T. Rouabah, A. Tounsi, N. E. Belaloui
arxiv-2005-13516.description: Abstract A dynamical epidemic model optimized using genetic algorithm and cross validation method to overcome the overfitting problem is proposed. The cross validation procedure is applied so that available data are split into a training subset used to fit the algorithm’s parameters, and a smaller subset used for validation.

arxiv-2102-04778.title: Exploring high-frequency eddy-current testing for sub-aperture defect characterisation using parametric-manifold mapping
arxiv-2102-04778.creator: Robert R. Hughes, Bruce W. Drinkwater
arxiv-2102-04778.description: Abstract Accurate characterisation of small defects remains a challenge in non-destructive testing (NDT). In this paper, a principle-component parametric-manifold mapping approach is applied to single-frequency eddy-current defect characterisation problems for surface breaking defects in a planar half-space. A broad 1-8 MHz frequency-range FE-circuit model & calibration approach is developed & validated to simulate eddy-current scans of surface-breaking notch defects.

arxiv-2103-15939.title: A Simple Approach for Zero-Shot Learning based on Triplet Distribution Embeddings
arxiv-2103-15939.creator: Vivek Chalumuri, Bac Nguyen
arxiv-2103-15939.description: Abstract Given the semantic descriptions of classes, Zero-Shot Learning (ZSL) aims to recognize unseen classes without labeled training data by exploiting semantic information, which contains knowledge between seen and unseen classes. Existing ZSL methods mainly use vectors to represent the embeddings to the semantic space.

arxiv-2109-02241.title: Supervised DKRC with Images for Offline System Identification
arxiv-2109-02241.creator: Alexander Krolicki, Pierre-Yves Lavertu
arxiv-2109-02241.description: Abstract Koopman spectral theory has provided a new perspective in the field of dynamical systems in recent years. Modern dynamical systems are becoming increasingly non-linear and complex, and there is a need for a framework to model these systems in a compact and comprehensive representation for prediction and control.

arxiv-2112-09406.title: The FUor Star V2493 Cyg (HBC 722)—Eleven Years at Maximum Brightness
arxiv-2112-09406.creator: Evgeni Semkov *, Sunay Ibryamov, Stoyanka Peneva
arxiv-2112-09406.description: Abstract At the time of stellar evolution, young stellar objects go through processes of increased activity and instability. Star formation takes place in several stages during which the star accumulates enough mass to initiate thermonuclear reactions in the nucleus. A significant percentage of the mass of Sun-like stars accumulates during periods of increased accretion known as FUor outbursts.

arxiv-2202-03884.title: GraphDCA – a Framework for Node Distribution Comparison in Real and Synthetic Graphs
arxiv-2202-03884.creator: Ciwan Ceylan, Petra Poklukar, Hanna Hultin, Alexander Kravchenko, Anastasia Varava, Danica Kragic
arxiv-2202-03884.description: Abstract We argue that when comparing two graphs, the distribution of node structural features is more informative than global graph statistics which are often used in practice, especially to evaluate graph generative models. Thus, we present GraphDCA – a framework for evaluating similarity between graphs based on the alignment of their respective node representation sets.

arxiv-2309-00326.title: Formulation of Galilean relativistic Born-Infeld theory
arxiv-2309-00326.creator: Rabin Banerjee 1, Soumya Bhattacharya 1, Bibhas Ranjan Majhi 2
arxiv-2309-00326.description: Abstract In this paper, we formulate, for the first time, in a systematic manner, Galilean relativistic Born-Infeld action in detail. Exploiting maps connecting Lorentz relativistic and Galilean relativistic vectors, we construct the two limits (electric and magnetic) of Galilean relativistic Born-Infeld action from usual relativistic Born-Infeld theory. An action formalism is thereby derived.

arxiv-2405-08750.title: Lepton-Pair Scattering With an Off-Shell and an On-Shell Photon at Two Loops in Massless QED
arxiv-2405-08750.creator: Simone Zoia
arxiv-2405-08750.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Simone Zoia. I present the computation of the two-loop amplitudes for the scattering of a lepton pair with an off-shell and an on-shell photon in massless QED. [ 1 ] We apply modern techniques developed to tackle QCD amplitudes with many scales: we express the Feynman integrals in terms of a basis of special functions, and reconstruct the amplitudes from numerical finite-field evaluations.

arxiv-2409-08035.title: Massive Star Formation Starts in Sub-virial Dense Clumps Unless Resisted by Strong Magnetic Fields Facilities: GBT, Spitzer , Herschel
arxiv-2409-08035.creator: Ke Wang, Yueluo Wang, Fengwei Xu
arxiv-2409-08035.description: Abstract The initial conditions are critical for understanding high-mass star formation, but are not well observed. Built on our previous characterization of a Galaxy-wide sample of 463 candidate high-mass starless clumps (HMSCs), here we investigate the dynamical state of a representative subsample of 44 HMSCs (radii 0.13-1.

arxiv-2412-06868.title: Compression for Better: A General and Stable Lossless Compression Framework
arxiv-2412-06868.creator: Boyang Zhang, Daning Cheng, Yunquan Zhang, Fangmin Liu, Wenguang Chen
arxiv-2412-06868.description: Abstract This work focus on how to stabilize and lossless model compression, aiming to reduce model complexity and enhance efficiency without sacrificing performance due to compression errors. A key challenge is effectively leveraging compression errors and defining the boundaries for lossless compression to minimize model loss. i.e., compression for better.

arxiv-2506-12647.title: Optimizing Blood Transfusions and Predicting Shortages in Resource-Constrained Areas
arxiv-2506-12647.creator: El Arbi Belfarsi , Sophie Brubaker Maria Valero Kennesaw State University, 1100 South Marietta Pkwy SE, Marietta, GA 30060 ebelfars@students.kennesaw.edu, sophie.brubaker@wheelermagnet.com, mvalero2@kennesaw.edu
arxiv-2506-12647.description: Abstract Our research addresses the critical challenge of managing blood transfusions and optimizing allocation in resource-constrained regions. We present heuristic matching algorithms for donor-patient and blood bank selection, alongside machine learning methods to analyze blood transfusion acceptance data and predict potential shortages.

arxiv-2506-23760.title: X ⁡ ( 3872 ) X(3872) and hidden charmed tetraquarks
arxiv-2506-23760.creator: You-You Lin, Ji-Ying Wang, Ailin Zhang
arxiv-2506-23760.description: Abstract In a constituent quark model, a hidden charmed tetraquark is assumed consisting of a c ​ q cq diquark and an c ¯ ​ q ¯ \bar{c}\bar{q} antidiquark or vice versa. The Semay-Silvestre-Brac potentials are employed to calculate the masses of c ​ q cq (q=u, d) diquarks.

arxiv-2601-00778.title: Achieving Extraordinary Acoustic Transmission in a Single Slit by Boundary Impedance Engineering
arxiv-2601-00778.creator: J. Sumaya-Martinez, J. Mulia-Rodriguez
arxiv-2601-00778.description: Abstract Extraordinary acoustic transmission (EAT) through subwavelength apertures is typically achieved using periodic arrays or external resonant elements. Here we demonstrate that strong and tunable EAT can be realized in a single isolated subwavelength slit by introducing one or more internal geometric constrictions.

arxiv-2602-17489.title: Prediction of room-temperature two-dimensional π \pi -electron half-metallic ferrimagnets
arxiv-2602-17489.creator: J. Phillips, J. C. G. Henriques, J. Fernández-Rossier, A. T. Costa
arxiv-2602-17489.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by J. Phillips, J. C. G. Henriques, J. Fernández-Rossier, A. T. Costa. We propose a strategy to obtain conducting organic materials with fully spin-polarized Fermi surface, lying at a singular flat band, with antiferromagnetically coupled magnetic moments that reside in pi-orbitals of nanographenes. We consider a honeycomb crystal whose unit cell combines two different molecules with S = 1 / 2 S=1/2 : an Aza-3-Triangulene, a molecule with orbital degeneracy, and a 2-Triangulene.

pmc-10735329.title: COMPARISON OF LONELINESS AND SOCIAL NETWORK BETWEEN OLDER ADULT CAREGIVERS AND NONCAREGIVERS
pmc-10735329.creator: Ting Yong, Abhijit Visaria, Rahul Malhotra
pmc-10735329.description: In ageing societies, more older adults are taking up informal caregiving roles. Caregivers, compared to non-caregivers, are found to have poorer psychosocial outcomes such as loneliness and social isolation in various studies. However, most of this research is not specific to older adult caregivers and does not account for selection bias into caregiving.

pmc-11356899.title: Alteration in the Morphological and Transcriptomic Profiles of Acinetobacter baumannii after Exposure to Colistin
pmc-11356899.creator: Eun-Jeong Yoon, Jun Won Mo, Jee-woong Kim, Min Chul Jeong, Jung Sik Yoo, Branka Bedenic
pmc-11356899.description: Acinetobacter baumannii is often highly resistant to multiple antimicrobials, posing a risk of treatment failure, and colistin is a “last resort” for treatment of the bacterial infection. However, colistin resistance is easily developed when the bacteria are exposed to the drug, and a comprehensive analysis of colistin-mediated changes in colistin-susceptible and -resistant A. baumannii is needed.

pmc-11406473.title: Endoscopic Ultrasound-Guided Radiofrequency Ablation of Metastatic Pancreatic VIPoma: A Novel Treatment
pmc-11406473.creator: Sundeep Lakhtakia, Kritin Mehrotra, Anuradha Sekaran, Srivenu Itha, Nageshwar Reddy Duvvur
pmc-11406473.description: VIPomas are a rare type of functional pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors (PNETs), causing symptoms due to their hypersecretion in the gastrointestinal tract. The rare association of PNETs with tumors of endocrine organs such as pituitary and parathyroid glands is called multiple endocrine neoplasia (MEN1) syndrome.

pmc-12474332.title: Comparative Study of DTMUV and LPS on Duck Liver Disease
pmc-12474332.creator: Zhenghui Lan, Zhigang Sun, Yi Wang, Huatao Li, Xuejing Sun
pmc-12474332.description: Simple SummaryThis study examined the structural characteristics of adult duck liver and compared pathological changes induced by duck Tembusu virus (DTMUV, strain XZ-2012) and lipopolysaccharide (LPS). The normal liver appeared reddish-brown with indistinct lobule boundaries and no prominent bile ducts. Kupffer cell distribution was mapped via jugular ink injection.

pmc-12518724.title: Large language models for patient education prior to interventional radiology procedures: a comparative study
pmc-12518724.creator: Bogdan Levita, Semil Eminovic, Willie Magnus Lüdemann, Dirk Schnapauff, Robin Schmidt, Anna-Maria Haack, Andrea Dell’Orco, Jawed Nawabi, Tobias Penzkofer
pmc-12518724.description: PurposeThis study evaluates four large language models’ (LLMs) ability to answer common patient questions preceding transarterial periarticular embolization (TAPE), computed tomography (CT)-guided high-dose-rate (HDR) brachytherapy, and bleomycin electrosclerotherapy (BEST). The goal is to evaluate their potential to enhance clinical workflows and patient comprehension, while also assessing associated risks.

pmc-12615528.title: Systemic Treatments in Moderate-to-Severe Atopic Dermatitis in Pediatric Patients up to 12 Years of Age: Real-World Treatment Outcomes from the PEDISTAD Registry
pmc-12615528.creator: Amy S. Paller, Danielle Marcoux, Michele Ramien, Eulalia Baselga, Vania Oliveira Carvalho, Ledit R. F. Ardusso, Marlies de Graaf, Suzanne Pasmans, Mirna Toledo-Bahena, Cory Rubin, Joel C. Joyce, Lara Wine Lee, Rajan Gupta, Bryan Adams, Marius Ardeleanu, Annie Zhang
pmc-12615528.description: BackgroundAtopic dermatitis (AD), a chronic systemic disease, can cause intense skin itching and negatively impact sleep, mood, and quality of life (QoL) for patients and families.MethodsPEDISTAD is an ongoing, 10-year, observational registry describing disease characteristics, atopic comorbidities, and treatment patterns in pediatric patients (aged <12 years at enrollment) with moderate-to-severe AD.

pmc-12764057.title: Liposomal bupivacaine: a delay rather than elimination of rebound pain in mouse postoperative model
pmc-12764057.creator: Hao Wu, Jiayu Jin, Di Zhou, Lihai Chen, Liu Han
pmc-12764057.description: BackgroundLiposomal bupivacaine (LB) provides prolonged analgesia, but it remains unclear whether it prevents rebound pain or merely delays its onset. This study investigated the effect of LB on rebound pain in a mouse model of peripheral nerve block to determine whether its resolution results in a pain response exceeding that of unblocked controls.
